name: pluneto-skills
description: Pluneto's Claude Code skills: plan and build workflows, skill maintenance, design and UX reviews.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Set up or repair the pluneto-skills plugins in a repo (/setup:setup-pluneto-skills). Install once at user scope.

plugins.name: skill-tools
plugins.description: Maintain skills: end-of-session reflect retro, skill-updater and skill-ozempic.

plugins.name: ux
plugins.description: UX analysis: user-types (UX/User_Types.md with MoSCoW requirements) and tool-for-users (feature-to-user mapping and journeys in UX/tools/).

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Plan, build, solve and research goals end to end (plan-this, build-this, solve-this, research-this, use-available-skills) plus handoff.
